event: Nala keeps her weight on its throat and does not ease off.
The whistle through the torn throat comes slower, then catches, then stops.
A last shiver runs down its body under her arms, and it is still.
She holds on a while longer, until she is sure. It does not come round.
[Level up! You have sixteen unspent stat points.]
[Level up! You have 24 unspent stat points.]
"System? Status?" she says, and then the rest of it comes out in a rush.
"Now would be a great time for a level up or some kind of regeneration talent."
"I feel like I've gotten a raw deal here."
"If I die now, I'll be complaining to Death about whoever brought me here."
No talent comes, and nothing in her eases; the pain in her leg and arms stays exactly as it was.
A column of blue boxes opens in front of her.
[Name: Nala]
[Class: Otherworlder (Earth) (Tier: Novice 4)]
[Health: 44/170]
[Strength: 8]
[Agility: 12]
[Arcana: 8]
[Constitution: 12]
[Spirit: 16]
The last line is greyed out, dimmer than the rest.
Under her, the dead beast's blood is soaking into the tights at her knees.
Her own calf is still bleeding into the glassgrass, slow and steady.
